snippet.title: DeckWrecking Pirates - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3995060/DeckWrecking_Pirates/

Command the ultimate pirate crew in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Roll the dice and bend fate itself — assign them to your crew or your foes to control every action. Unleash brutal grid-based combos, and plunder items and relics. Build your pirate deck… and wreck enemy decks.

- Deep Tactical Combat - Assign dice to allies or enemies to decide which actions they perform. Outsmart your foes and reduce RNG with clever strategy.
- Bend Fate, Your Way - Win battles by defeating enemy pirates or sinking their ship.
- Recruit and Manage a legendary crew - Choose your route carefully. Recruit and equip pirates from different clans, upgrade dice, plunder relics that shape your run, and discover powerful synergies.
- Master the Art of Pirate Combos
- Quick Runs, Endless Replay – Conquer the seas in approx. 1-hour sessions, with save-anytime freedom.
- Personalize Your Starting Run – Choose different captains, starting powers, and ship combinations.
- Undo & Preview Systems – Test wild combos, preview every outcome, and undo turns if you’re not satisfied.

🎮 Sign in for the Playtest: https://dracblau.substack.com/
🔔 Subscribe to this channel: https://www.youtube.com/ ⁨@DracBlauStudio⁩  
🐦 Follow us on Twitter: https://x.com/DracBlauStudio
